Doing things isn't easy. 
Video games are hard, as someone once said I forget who, but it's an actual quote. I think it may be from an executive. I dunno.

Being a niche indie company is hard.

Hired a new writer for [b]Spooky Cat Girls?[/b]'s classroom scenes when it became clear that it would not make a reasonable launch date for October. It was either launch directly before the Halloween sale (and this was hoping Valve would accept the final build on the first submission, never something a designer should bet on) or delay it, and we chose to delay it. We feel December also fits in with the theme of the chosen play.

[b]Super Army of Tentacles[/b] has always been my baby, but it's gone through so many changes, due to gameplay as well as personal reasons, that I feel a disconnect with it. Rather than make a tentpole game that I do not want to make, I handed it off to another team member for a 2023 release. This would be the first Army of Tentacles game not helmed by me, which is exciting as I 100% trust my team and think it is time that we all grow in that fashion. We've been alive almost five-point-something years now.

In the place of [b]Super Army of Tentacles[/b], I plan on making a new, full VN-RPG Army of Tentacles game. I feel much more confident about this one, and it will launch at the same time that [b]Super Army 2022[/b] would have. That will be announced soon, maybe with the other 2022 games. Maybe not. Making games is hard.

So, we're putting the finishing touches on Midsummer, and without going into the gory details, a large chunk of the gameplay was vaporized from existence: the weekly slasher competitions. notes.title: Super Army of Tentacles, progress update + news
notes.notes:
So. 
Dunno if this announcement is really warranted. Just want to let people know what is going on. 

[b]Super Army of Tentacles: (Not) A Cthulhu Dating Sim[/b] has three main mechanics: skills/attributes, Word Battles, and Armies.

Well, it did. See, I started work on the project when things were.... let's say, different in the USA, and that, in turn, fueled the direction of the thing. We had already wanted to do something new with AoT 1's army mechanic, but do it better than the first game. Do it with all the game dev we had learned over the years since we've started. So I felt that my internal anger was a good fuel for said mechanic. Who doesn't love a good 'throw out the bad guys' story?

While the main story of the game is still 'the humans somehow occupied Monster Land', after recent events, I just don't feel good about a mechanic where you pre-meditatively build up militias to take over areas. We talked about this, and the bottom line is that we feel that even though the Army mechanic would have been solid, it would have taken away from the main gameplay loop of the first two games. Even though there was a final Invasion mechanic in the first game, the way you recruited your army was never the focal point. The focals were the Word Battles. 

At the end of the day, real people make games, and we don't want to be making a game that we feel isn't up to snuff or is pushed in two different directions. This is the last in the trilogy for us. We know more now and want to do it right, as both a stand alone title and a series cap.

This also allows us to put greater focus on the idea of reactivity to your choices in the world's hubs. Which is cool. 

I'm writing this because, even though it wasn't the selling point of the game or even showcased in screenshots or the trailer, it was in the initial store description and there were shots of it in the trailer and on the screenshot gallery. We've already updated the gallery, but will also be updating the trailer shortly. 

This really doesn't affect the already delayed release date of 2022. If anything, it clarifies a release date. If anything, at max what it means is this will release post-summer 2022, but I honestly don't think that's a concern.

Had we all the time and money in the world, all three would be coming out before summer 2021, but that workload would eventually hurt Army of Tentacles 2021. Yes, one could bring up the claim that having an investor has affected us, but only in the sense of what products come first (and that honestly is the ideal situation). notes.notes:
Announcing the final 2020 games. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1349170/Furries__Scalies__Bears_OH_MY_2_Return_to_Kale_Bay

Sequel to the first Furries/Bears, but can 100% be played as a stand-alone story. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1312380/Paper_Shakespeare_Very_Naked_Hamlet/

A silly little game where you need to know the entirety of Hamlet. It's like those learning to spell good games, but with sexytimes and Shakespeare. It was also a big back-and-forth for us, as it has text-based sex scenes baked in that go further than we've gone in a base game. 

[h1]Release date changes[/h1]
[b]Paper Shakes: Date? 2[/b] is going to launch sooner, as Furries/Bears 2 has taken priority as our late year game. This doesn't mean that it will be less of a game. notes.title: Self-Isolation and Indie Development Update

You'd think that self-isolation would be great for an indie dev, right?
Forced to be inside?

Well, yes and no. More no than yes. 

Release dates are all sorts of wacky right now. Halloween Times is going to hit its mark, but Rainbow Hollow may slip.  I recently moved to Boston, and as such, have not been able to fully focus on game development. I'm taking a few days for myself until my work computer arrives late this week. Even then, I'm all out of sorts and discombobulated from both being in a new city, and not being able to get my bearings because of COVID-19 and the mess it caused.  Oh, and I feel like I'm getting sick. No, not COVID symptoms, more like weird stomach stuff.

I've got a schedule, but it is pretty tight, and when push comes to shove, it doesn't look good for the experiment known as Rainbow Hollow getting out anytime soon. I'm much more confident of getting Halloween Times out before summer, and even then, it is going to miss April completely for a May launch. Maybe. We'll see. 

In the coming weeks, we'll be putting up a poll and a forum thread about what people liked and disliked about the first two Army of Tentacles games. Take into mind that we would be revamping the quest, inventory, and attribute/stat systems regardless of comments and criticism. 

Stay safe out there.

notes.title: Year Update: EXPACK 3 DELAYED, EXPACK 2.5 NOW IN EXISTENCE
notes.notes:
So, regarding my recent medical discovery, my upcoming surgery, and the financial/biological factors involved, here is what we've decided to do:
[olist]
    [*] EXPACK 3 is delayed to [b]at least[/b] February. If we have to delay the Dating Sim DLC a few months, Valentine's Day is the best substitute launch of the bunch. 
    [*] There will be a new DLC for December to fill the void: EXPACK 2.5, which we have decided to call [b]CHILDREN OF THE OLD GODS[/b]. It will be much smaller than EXPACK 3 (which, judging by our plot outline, is going to actually be pretty big; adding about an hour to two hours worth of new content). It will most likely have two new quests, and limited new art if any at all.
[/olist]
Why [b]CHILDREN OF THE OLD GODS[/b]? 
    [*] [b]GNOME[/b] was all about fleshing out the Time Vortex crisis. 
    [*] [b]HALLOWEEN[/b] (of which we have maybe three final names picked out and are deciding between right now) is going to explore the Children of Nodens that are briefly mentioned in your home base. Unlike the Children of Dagon or any of the other Old Gods, the Children of Nodens are a human cult. We have never explored cult politics in our world before.
    [*] [b]NEW GAME+ BENEFITS 2[/b] is to be the funny lil' dating sim content. But we also want to tie up the loose end of where the hell exactly the Old Gods are going when they vanish from the face of the planet. Is it all a part of the bad guys master plan, or is it something else?
    [*] [b]CHILDREN OF THE OLD GODS[/b] is to be a story parallel to the before-mentioned cult politics plot. What about the new generation, born either after or shortly before the Lovecraftian Apocalypse? What does it mean to be a Child of Old God Y if you've never known a world in which the Old Gods were asleep and not fighting Old God X? 
[/list]
We're also working hard on [i]not[/i] having to push The Ghost of Joe Papp. 

The Desert Bus/Child's Play outfit pack will be out late next week.

notes.title: Year Update: Some medical tomfoolery.
notes.notes:
Bryy here (I mean, it's always safe to assume that I'm the one writing these things because, 90% of the time, I am). Update on the rest of the year.

Earlier this morning, I ran into some medical issues - some old war wounds that decided they would like to wish me a late happy birthday. Nothing major, and even the definition of the surgery I need is minor. Which is a let-down, as I totally would have been cool with looking up the classification and finding that it just passes for MAJOR SURGERY. 

However, having had this surgery at least once in my lifetime, I can tell you that the recovery process is rather long and hard on the body. 

But on to the meat.
What does this mean for the rest of the year?
[list]
    [*][b]CHARITY DLC #3: DESERT BUS[/b]: Moved from this week to most likely next week due to doctor visits.
    [*][b]SPOOPY! SALE[/b]: Expect it to be moved to late this month and downsized to Army 3 only. There will still be an Army 1 sale in mid-October.
    [*][b]HALLOWEEN QUEST AND OUTFIT PACK[/b]: Still on track for October 13th.
    [*][b]NEW GAME+ BENEFITS 2 EXPANSION PACK[/b]: Depends on recovery. If the surgery is in November, expect NG+B2 in January. If December, expect February.
    [*][b]The Ghost of Joe Papp[/b]: Same as NG+B2. Depends on recovery. If the surgery is in November, expect Joe Papp in January. If December, expect February.
[/list]

notes.title: Halloween DLC update(!) & future charity DLC(?)
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28698999/fb08d90be0faf7369d30961ee5bf7cfefba68d3a.jpg[/img]

[h1]HALLOWEEN[/h1]

The next quest pack, the Halloween Pack (name tbd), will feature two quests as well as two outfits packs - for a total of 28 outfits..... total.

Twitch Con is right before Halloween this year, and while the original plan was to have two separate Halloween DLC packs, we thought combining them made more sense. The Twitch Con pack will be more game-related. 

All of the Halloween outfits are in various stages of completion.
The Twitch Con outfits come next.

After Twitch Con, the new character art for the new quests will be hammered out. We have 3 new bosses (4 if you count branching paths) and a host of new characters to interact with. 

Expect the Halloween DLC to drop on Friday the 13th.

[h1]POTENTIAL NEW CHARITY DLCs[/h1]

One for Army 1, one for Army 3. We're discussing making a DISASTER RELIF pack for Army 1 (with the profits initially going towards Harvey and Irma relief) as well as a CHILD'S PLAY/DESERT BUS FOR HOPE outfit pack for Army 3. 

Once again, all profits would go towards various charities around the globe. We wouldn't see a cent.

Those would drop this month, presumably.

- Various typos.

GENERAL:

- pauses have been taken out of the code and replaced with timed dissolves.

- Typos fixed.

- Ganymede's images during random conversations in your base have been fixed.
